algorithm: Shared chronological prefixes of independent fixed-state replays; one fitted readout per root and window; no interpolation, smoothing, or new loss-rate selection.
interval: 10th-90th percentiles of 24 root-level scores; not confidence intervals
metric: Test RMSE divided by training-target standard deviation
scope: Post hoc every-window extension on the unchanged archived 24-root cohort; not a fresh replication or new model/loss selection.

specification.numerical_addendum: After the documented first-root diagnostic, archived metrics and first-trace predictions use an absolute 1e-5 cross-runtime bound. Exact alpha/gamma/features, strict target identity, and strict same-runtime feature equivalence are unchanged. Initial failed attempt remains archived; no fit or outcome selection changed.

numerical_reproducibility.interpretation: Frozen and optimized replay agree exactly on this host. Archived differences are concentrated in ill-conditioned alpha=1e-8 normal-equation fits; no targets, selected settings, physics or splits were changed. Initial strict cross-runtime gate failed; no extension result was published.
